  mode=$1

  if [[ ! -z $ZENO_ENABLE_SOCK ]]; then

    else
      start-zeno-server
      local out=$(echo "${input}" | zeno --mode=${mode})
    fi
  else
    local out=$(echo "${input}" | zeno --mode=${mode})
  fi

}```

attachments.title: <https://github.com/starship/starship/pull/3026|#3026 feat: Add support for RPROMPT (right prompt)>
attachments.text:
*Description*

Many shells support a right prompt that appears on the far right hand side of the input line. This change makes it easy to configure a right prompt with starship.

This change adds a `right_format` to the config for specifying the format of the right prompt. Modules that are included explicitly in `format` or `right_format` are removed from `$all` to avoid redundant output. A new clap flag `--right` tells starship to output the right prompt instead of the default (left) prompt.

I've updated the init scripts for fish, zsh and elvish, but only tested with zsh so far.

*Motivation and Context*

While it is possible to set the right prompt using starship today, it is cumbersome. The user must create an alternate config file and manually configure their shell to use it. What's more, the user would likely have to modify their main config format in order to move modules to the right prompt.

This feature seems to be a recurring request:  
<https://github.com/starship/starship/issues/2925|#2925>  
<https://github.com/starship/starship/issues/387|#387>

There's even a pull request that shipped that canonizes the workaround for xonsh:  
<https://github.com/anki-code/xontrib-prompt-starship/pull/3|anki-code/xontrib-prompt-starship#3>  
This change would allow users of that workaround to simplify their configuration.

*Screenshots (if appropriate):*

Example config:  
<https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1189194/131586118-c08c0399-929c-4159-887d-5f40b8d7895c.png|Screen Shot 2021-08-31 at 3 36 45 PM>  
Result:  
<https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1189194/131586102-effd7410-99d6-459a-88d6-b03861c0da83.png|Screen Shot 2021-08-31 at 3 36 26 PM>

*How Has This Been Tested?*

☑︎ I have tested using *MacOS*
☐ I have tested using *Linux*
☐ I have tested using *Windows*

Tested in zsh, but can easily be added to the init script for any shell that supports right prompts.

*Checklist:*

☑︎ I have updated the documentation accordingly.
☑︎ I have updated the tests accordingly.
